A LETTER FOR YOU

My Dearest Baku... ❤️

Do you really think we just happened to meet? No, Baku! It was Dada who brought us together.

The very first time I saw you was during my interview. Then, in the canteen, my turn came right after yours. And the way you randomly explained something to me… that couldn't have been just a coincidence, could it?

Then, we ended up in the same department. Even though we were in different sections, our department was the same, right?

And that's not all! Eventually, we even ended up on the same floor.

One night, something happened, and your Teams was open. I saw your name there, searched for you on Instagram, and sent you a follow request. And you accepted it too!

Then, you sent me your very first message:

"Hey, what are your shift timings?"

And just like that, Baku, our conversations began.

Baku, Dada has brought us this far, and I pray that our togetherness continues just like this, forever.

This is not where our journey ends. We have a whole lifetime ahead of us, and we are going to spend it together.

Forever yours, and forever mine... ❤️

All of this has happened only because of Dada's blessings.

Mast Bakuuuuuuuuu! ❤️❤️
